failure_modes.mode: Channel blockage due to precipitate formation
failure_modes.cause: Electrophilic Aromatic Substitution products or salts have low solubility in the industrial solvent at 60°C, leading to crystallization in the 0.75 mm ID coil
failure_modes.mitigation: Implement online UV-Vis monitoring for turbidity; add co-solvent or adjust concentration to maintain solubility margin >20%

failure_modes.mode: Incomplete mixing leading to selectivity loss
failure_modes.cause: Laminar flow (Re=16) relies on diffusion; if feed streams are not perfectly aligned or if viscosity changes occur, radial mixing is insufficient for the selectivity-sensitive mechanism
failure_modes.mitigation: Validate mixing efficiency using a fast clock reaction (e.g., iodine clock) at identical Re and geometry; ensure static mixers or optimized T-junction design

failure_modes.mode: Pressure surge due to BPR malfunction or blockage
failure_modes.cause: Back Pressure Regulator (BPR) failure or partial blockage by solids causes pressure to exceed pump limit or coil rating, risking rupture or leak
failure_modes.mitigation: Install pressure relief valve set at 1.5x operating pressure; use redundant pressure sensors with automatic pump shutdown

single_points_of_failure: BPR valve — blockage stops all flow and causes pressure buildup
Single pump head — failure halts production and may cause thermal runaway if reaction is exothermic
validation_experiments: Run 24-hour continuous flow with product stream analysis for precipitate formation via inline particle counter
Perform mixing validation using a fast kinetic probe reaction at Re=16 to confirm selectivity matches batch
Simulate BPR blockage by manually restricting outlet and verify pressure relief valve activation and pump shutdown within 5 seconds
